name: Huevos fritos
description: Eggs fried in oil until the whites are set and the yolks reach the desired consistency.

steps.title: Heat the oil
steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Crack the eggs into the skillet and cook until the whites are set.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.text: Add salt to taste and serve immediately.

name: Omelette
description: A dish made with beaten eggs cooked in a skillet and folded around melted cheese.

steps.title: Beat the eggs
steps.text: Beat the eggs with milk, salt, and pepper in a bowl.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.text: Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.text: Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges begin to set.

steps.title: Add the cheese
steps.text: Sprinkle the grated cheese over one half of the omelette.

steps.title: Fold and serve
steps.text: Fold the omelette in half and cook until the eggs are fully set and the cheese melts.

name: Huevo picado o revuelto
description: Scrambled eggs cooked with onion and sweet pepper for a simple, flavorful breakfast.

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.text: Finely chop the onion and sweet pepper.

steps.title: Sauté the vegetables
steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the vegetables until softened.

steps.title: Beat the eggs
steps.text: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt in a bowl.

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.text: Pour the eggs into the skillet and stir gently until fully cooked.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Remove from the heat and serve warm.

name: Tostadas francesas
description: Slices of bread dipped in a sweet egg and milk mixture, then cooked until golden brown.

steps.title: Prepare the mixture
steps.text: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, and cinnamon in a shallow bowl.

steps.title: Dip the bread
steps.text: Dip each slice of bread into the mixture, coating both sides.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.text: Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat.

steps.title: Cook the toast
steps.text: Cook each slice until golden brown on both sides and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm with fruit, honey, or syrup if desired.

name: Panqueques
description: Fluffy pancakes made from a simple batter of flour, milk, and eggs, cooked until golden.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.text: Combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.text: Add the egg, milk, and melted butter. Mix until combined.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.text: Lightly grease a skillet and heat it over medium heat.

steps.title: Cook the pancakes
steps.text: Pour small portions of batter into the skillet. Cook until bubbles form on the surface.

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.text: Flip each pancake and cook until the other side is golden brown.

name: Sándwich de desayuno
description: A toasted sandwich filled with egg, cheese, and ham for a quick and satisfying breakfast.

steps.title: Cook the egg
steps.text: Heat a skillet and cook the egg to your preferred doneness.

steps.title: Toast the bread
steps.text: Lightly butter the bread and toast both slices until golden.

steps.title: Assemble the sandwich
steps.text: Place the cheese, ham, and cooked egg on one slice of bread.

steps.title: Melt the cheese
steps.text: Close the sandwich and heat briefly until the cheese begins to melt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cut in half and serve while warm.

name: Gallo pinto
description: A traditional Costa Rican breakfast made with rice, black beans, onion, sweet pepper, and cilantro.
ingredients: 1 cup cooked black beans with a little broth

steps.title: Chop the vegetables
steps.text: Finely chop the onion, sweet pepper, and cilantro.

steps.title: Sauté the vegetables
steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the onion and sweet pepper until softened.

steps.title: Add the beans
steps.text: Add the black beans with a little broth and stir.

steps.title: Add the rice
steps.text: Add the cooked rice and mix thoroughly with the beans.

steps.title: Season the pinto
steps.text: Add Lizano sauce to taste and cook for a few minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot.

name: Avena con frutos
description: Warm oatmeal topped with fresh fruit, honey, and cinnamon for a nutritious breakfast.

steps.title: Cook the oats
steps.text: Combine the oats and milk or water in a saucepan.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Cook over medium heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy.

steps.title: Prepare the fruit
steps.text: Slice the banana and chop the strawberries.

steps.title: Add the toppings
steps.text: Transfer the oatmeal to a bowl and top with the fruit, honey, and cinnamon.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm.

name: Granola con yogurt
description: A refreshing breakfast bowl of creamy yogurt, crunchy granola, fresh fruit, and honey.

steps.title: Prepare the yogurt
steps.text: Place the yogurt in a bowl.

steps.title: Add the granola
steps.text: Sprinkle the granola evenly over the yogurt.

steps.title: Add the fruit
steps.text: Slice the banana and add it with the chopped strawberries.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Drizzle with honey and serve immediately to keep the granola crunchy.

name: Tostadas de aguacate
description: Crispy toast topped with creamy mashed avocado, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Toast the bread
steps.text: Toast the bread slices until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Prepare the avocado
steps.text: Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.

steps.title: Mash and season
steps.text: Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Assemble the toast
steps.text: Spread the avocado mixture evenly over the toasted bread.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drizzle with olive oil if desired and serve immediately.

name: Chorreadas
description: Traditional Costa Rican sweet corn pancakes, soft inside and golden outside, often served with sour cream or cheese.

steps.title: Blend the corn
steps.text: Blend the corn kernels with the egg and milk until you get a thick mixture.

steps.title: Prepare the batter
steps.text: Add the flour, salt, and optional sugar. Mix until combined.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.text: Lightly grease a skillet and heat it over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Cook the chorreadas
steps.text: Pour a portion of batter into the skillet and cook until the edges become firm.

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.text: Carefully flip the pancake and cook the other side until golden and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm with sour cream or cheese if desired.

name: Tortillas con queso
description: Homemade corn tortillas mixed with grated cheese and cooked on a skillet until golden.
ingredients: 1 cup corn masa or tortilla flour

steps.title: Prepare the dough
steps.text: Mix the corn masa or tortilla flour with the salt and grated cheese.

steps.title: Add water
steps.text: Gradually add warm water and mix until a soft, manageable dough forms.

steps.title: Shape the tortillas
steps.text: Divide the dough into small balls and flatten them into round tortillas.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.text: Lightly grease a skillet and heat it over medium heat.

steps.title: Cook the tortillas
steps.text: Cook each tortilla on both sides until golden and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot while the cheese is still soft.
